title: Minimum Coin Queries
statement:
Precompute the minimum number of unlimited coins for all queried sums.

Input
n q, then n denominations, then q targets.

Output
For each target print the minimum count or −1 if unreachable. Zero needs zero coins.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 50. Denominations are distinct integers in [1,100000]. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Each target is in [0,100000].
